heroSub: Hand-painted originals inspired by Australian native flora, created one canvas at a time on the Redcliffe Peninsula. Each piece is painted to hold a feeling, using layered colour and tonal depth to bring warmth, softness and a quiet connection to nature.
statement: Inspired by Australia's native flora, I paint atmospheric botanical artworks using layered colour and translucent depth. Each original is created to capture a feeling rather than a perfect representation of nature.
galleryIntro: Each painting is a one-off original. Tap any piece to see it up close.
upcomingIntro: Pieces currently on the easel. Join the early access list to see them before they're listed.
aboutBody: I'm a graphic designer by trade and a painter by passion, creating contemporary Australian botanical artworks from the Redcliffe Peninsula in Queensland.
aboutBody2: Painting has always been my dream, but for now you'll usually find me at the easel on weekends, slowly building each original one layer at a time. Every background is created through multiple layers of colour and glazing, giving each piece its soft, atmospheric depth. I then bring Australia's native flora to life with delicate contour lines, textured details and subtle tonal highlights, creating botanicals that feel both contemporary and timeless.
aboutBody3: Each painting is an original, inspired by the quiet beauty of Australia's landscape and designed to bring warmth, softness and a sense of calm into your home.
aboutBody4: Every original comes with a signed Certificate of Authenticity.
earlyAccessBody: New paintings go to this list before they're listed anywhere else, with first pick before a piece goes public.
earlyAccessNote: No spam. Just new work and the occasional studio note.
contactBody: Whether you're asking about an available painting, thinking about a commission, or just want to see what's coming next — I'd love to hear from you.
contactDeliveryNote: Local delivery available on the Redcliffe Peninsula
footerNote: All artworks, images and reproductions are the property of the artist.
